root_cause: Wall-clock latency assertion (<50 ms) against a call with random 0-80 ms jitter; fails nondeterministically on the same commit.
acceptable_fix: Remove or relax the wall-clock assertion, or inject/mock the delay.
title: Latency assertion races a jittery cache
rubric_change: v1.1: evidence matcher also accepts 'wall-clock', 'latency', or a millisecond figure. v1.0 required the literal word 'timing' and failed a correct diagnosis.
